$comment: Gzipped, minified bytes per entry, the whole entry bundled (external: what a consumer already has). Raised only by a decision written in ROADMAP.md. Phase 2 close (2026-10-16): each budget is the measure + 10 %, under §5.2's ceilings (dom 30 kB, locales 2 kB, theme 9 kB). Profiles from K.8: audit screen <= 85 000 (Phase 3), everything but charts <= 150 000; the read-only client grid profile is recorded (31.3 kB). Phase 3 (decision in ROADMAP, plan §4): the DOM base is expected near 15 kB with the features seam, the popup host and the parts; budget 16.5 kB during the phase, set at the measure + 10 % at its close. /server (the request gate at step 3) grows at steps 4-5 and is set again then. Owner decision (2026-10-17, step 4): core 24 kB and dom 16.8 kB during Phase 3 (paging in the client model went over), each set at the measure + 10 % at the phase's close. Step 5 part 2 (2026-10-17): /server measured whole (16 081 B gz, budget 17 690), which bundles the client model `sourceRows` builds on; over the base it adds 2 386 B (ROADMAP). /server is measured over the core (what it adds to a grid that already has the core: both bundled, less the core alone), from step 5. Step 5 part 3 (2026-10-17): cursors and the fetched set, 2 726 B over the core, budget 3 000 (measure + 10 %). Owner decision (2026-10-17, step 5 review): dom 17.5 kB during Phase 3 (the grid on a server went over 16.8; step 11 adds default parts to the base), reset to the measure + 10 % at the close. Owner decision (2026-10-17, before step 6): /server 6 kB during Phase 3 (the plan's ceiling for it), reset to the measure + 10 % at the close. Step 6 (2026-10-17): toWire, 4 159 B gz over the core (was 2 743), under the 6 kB. Step 7 (2026-10-18): three announcement keys in every bundle (selectedAll, selectionCleared, selectionReduced) took the locales over their Phase 2 budgets (en 511, fr 623, ar 801 B gz): en 540, fr 660, ar 850 until the owner confirms (ROADMAP step 7). Owner decision (2026-10-18, step 7): locales en 540, fr 660, ar 850 B during Phase 3 (the selection announcements), reset to the measure + 10 % at the close. Owner decision (2026-10-18, step 8 test analysis): core 26 kB during Phase 3 (24 054 measured; step 9's value lists and step 10's CSV to come), reset to the measure + 10 % at the close.
